title: Base change and etale descent of closed subsets proper over the base
statement: Let $p:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let $C\subseteq T$ be a closed subset. A closed subset is proper over its base when its reduced induced closed subscheme is proper [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. (1) For any $v:S'\to S$, let $T'=T\times_SS'$ with projection $v_T:T'\to T$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If $C$ is proper over $S$, then $v_T^{-1}(C)$ is proper over $S'$. (2) If $\{v_i:S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ is a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] and every inverse image $C_i\subseteq T\times_SS_i$ is proper over $S_i$, then $C$ is proper over $S$. No quasi-compactness assumption is made on $p$, $S$, or the members of the etale covering.

proof.text: Let i:Z→T be the canonical reduced induced closed immersion with image C, using the vanishing-ideal subscheme API of [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme]. For w:S′→S put q:T×_S S′→T. Pull i back along q; the second projection j:Z×_T(T×_S S′)→T×_S S′ is a closed immersion by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change]. Mathlib Scheme.Pullback.range_snd states range(j)=q⁻¹(range(i)), hence its image is precisely q⁻¹(C). This replaces the affine tensor-quotient calculation with the existing proved pullback-carrier theorem. Paste the two pullback squares by IsPullback.paste_vert to see that j followed by T×_S S′→S′ is the base change of i followed by p.

The ambient projection $p\prime:T\prime\to S\prime$ is locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change]. If $C$ is proper over $S$, then $Z\prime\to S\prime$ is proper by [lem-weil-pbc-proper-base-change]. Applying [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties](1) to the closed subscheme $Z\prime\subset T\prime$ constructed in step 1 shows that its underlying subset $v_T^{-1}(C)$ is proper over $S\prime$. This proves (1); no assertion that $Z\prime$ is reduced is needed.

For (2), each $S_i\to S$ is an object of the small etale site of $S$, and their jointly surjective family covers its identity object by the covering-family definition in [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Hence [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-finer-than-etale] makes it an fpqc covering. For each $i$ let $Z_i=Z\times_SS_i\subset T_i=T\times_SS_i$. Step 1 identifies its underlying closed subset with $C_i$. The ambient $T_i\to S_i$ is locally of finite type by [lem-weil-pbc-lft-base-change]. Since $C_i$ is proper by hypothesis, [lem-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base-properties](1), now in its every-closed-structure direction, shows that $Z_i\to S_i$ is proper. Reducedness of $Z_i$ is neither asserted nor required.

For every covering member, step 3 gives properness of the morphism from the iterated pullback Z×_T(T×_S S_i) to S_i. The pasted pullback square of step 1 supplies its canonical isomorphism to Z×_S S_i. Its inverse followed by the iterated projection is the canonical second projection, by IsPullback.isoPullback_inv_snd. Properness is preserved under composition with this isomorphism. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proper-morphism-fpqc-descent] to i followed by p and the fpqc cover of step 3. The conclusion is exactly [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base], proving (2), with no quasi-compactness hypotheses.

lean.statement: theorem closed_proper_support_locality {T S : Scheme.{u}} (p : T ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (C : TopologicalSpace.Closeds T) : (∀ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (w : S' ⟶ S), IsClosedSubsetProperOver p C → IsClosedSubsetProperOver (pullback.snd p w) (C.preimage (pullback.fst p w).continuous)) ∧ (∀ (I : Type v) (Sᵢ : I → Scheme.{u}) (w : ∀ i, Sᵢ i ⟶ S) [∀ i, Etale (w i)], (∀ s : S, ∃ (i : I) (x : Sᵢ i), w i x = s) → (∀ i, IsClosedSubsetProperOver (pullback.snd p (w i)) (C.preimage (pullback.fst p (w i)).continuous)) → IsClosedSubsetProperOver p C)
